decisions: D1 packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/intake-draft.ts:49 zipParentWords is the one place that words a ZIP's own item, from its card only: a layer is a member with format geojson and no refusalCode (the predicate of zipLayerMembers); directory entries are skipped; others carry their refusalCode or 'not a map layer'. One layer reads '1 map layer in this ZIP is taken in as its own file'.

D1 intake-draft.ts:35 listWords names whole paths within a character budget (800 layers, 900 others, 1800 when N = 0) so the words stay within limit_reason's 2000 characters; the rest end 'and <k> more'. A path is never cut; if none fits, the list reads '<k> with long paths'. A ZIP with no listed member reads 'No member of it could be listed.'

D1 intake-draft.ts:31 and :70 shapefileZip names the existing shapefile condition once; a ZIP with a shapefile member keeps today's words (intakeDraftLimit) and today's no-transition. intakeDraftLimit returns the ZIP words at :74 for any other ZIP.

D2 intake-draft.ts:118 and :149 settleZipParentTx: a probe publication of a non-shapefile ZIP card sets the ZIP's own probed item to state read, placement undecided, with the words as limit_reason. The ledger allows it (intake-ledger.sql: no transition guard) and Studio isSettled is true for read; the tray's Reason column shows limit_reason. A re-probe resets it to probed (saveIntakeCardTx) and the same publication settles it again.

D2 finding: before this change the ZIP's own item (family archive) stopped at the family gate in queueIntakeDraftTx and rested probed/undecided, so the tray waited on it; the settlement runs before that gate.

D3 apps/studio/src/features/intake/file-route.ts:41 zipRoute: any member ending .shp (any case) routes direct; every other ZIP, an unreadable one included, routes to the batch. The Add files help sentence stays true and is unchanged.
limits: The words come from the probe card, so a layer later refused by the fan-out (ZIP_LAYER_LIMIT, ZIP_LAYER_SIZE, a failed retain) is still named as taken in on the ZIP's item; its own member row carries the refusal.
No PostgreSQL, object store, processor or served HTTP walk was run.
